rav-asi.name: Rav Asi
rav-asi.bio: Babylonian Amora of the first generation, a colleague of Rav and Shmuel.
rav-asi.prompt: A dignified Babylonian sage in his 60s with a full greying beard and a calm, deliberate expression, a dark wool mantle over a linen robe, as one of the early masters who sat alongside Rav and Shmuel. Mudbrick study house of a Babylonian town with oil lamps softly behind him.

rabbi-yirmeya.name: Rabbi Yirmeya
rabbi-yirmeya.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who settled in the Land of Israel, known for his probing and provocative questions.
rabbi-yirmeya.prompt: A wiry, quick-witted scholar in his 40s with a mischievous, questioning look and a raised finger mid-question; he was once sent out of the study hall for asking one question too many. Simple dark robe. Tiberias study hall with limestone arches behind him.
